summary: Without a readable board.txt, agent board now places a failed run's card in its stage's column with Needs you.

criteria.132.1: dokima/agent.py main() 'board': when board.txt is missing or unreadable, board_place(record, ('stop',)) puts the issue and its open PR in the record's stage column with Needs you; runs that decided still use board.txt, so a hand-on keeps the pill cleared.
criteria.132.2: dokima/agent.py main() 'board': with no record.json either, it falls back to the job's ROLE and STAGE env for the column, sets Needs you, and exits 0.
